title: Launch orchestration: SDK/API v2 GA — docs, samples, release notes and enablement
creator: Hannah Cho
description: Coordinate GA launch for SDK/API v2 covering function-calling, structured output, and streaming surfaces. Deliver a set of synchronized assets: final release notes, detailed changelog, docs pages with canonical examples, three lighthouse sample apps with CI, internal enablement materials, and a post-launch monitoring and rollback runbook.
acceptance_criteria: Final release notes approved by Legal and Product Communications
Docs updated with full API reference, structured-output schema guide, streaming session semantics and code examples in Python, JS, and Go
Three lighthouse samples published in the SDK samples repo with CI green and README walkthroughs
Console rollout flags and staged enablement plan implemented
Canary plan defined with automatic rollback thresholds and monitoring dashboards
test_plan: Run E2E smoke tests for generation + function-calling across official SDKs
Structured-output validation against golden prompts with validator CLI integrated in CI
Streaming resilience tests: reconnect, backpressure, and latency percentiles under k6 scenario
Canary progression: 5% -> 25% -> 100% over 48 hours with health checks and 5xx thresholds
